notes: Working tree changes are benchmark harnesses and documentation, no kernel/server behavior changes.
Upstream east: 3 measured samples plus one warmup per size.
Rust east/headon and grid-check diagnostics: 5 measured samples plus one warmup per size.
Server pipe: 3 samples per size, no discarded warmup; worker disabled, stub provider.
Benchmarks run sequentially; setup builds may overlap upstream samples. Shared machine, no exclusive CPU reservation.
GPU pipe adds used_gpu to the existing sim-tick trace and enables that trace in the harness; CPU pipe was measured before this logging-only change. Kernel and simulation behavior are identical.
GPU pipe samples reject CPU fallback by checking that nowMs is unchanged; setup ticks can fall back while direct engine inserts change player count. Two exploratory/interrupted GPU runs are excluded.
